subject: Re: InfiniteNature-Zero kickoff — perpetual view generation
body: Decision after yesterday's sync: we're cutting the custom-corpus retrain from Q2 scope. The coastal-drift work is promising but not demo-stable, and I'm not risking the LRB slot on it. Revised plan: ship the demo on the pretrained LHQ checkpoint with Saoirse's Shipyard deployment; keep Csilla's resampled-mix experiments running as background work and fold the retrain into Q3 planning. The July compute week stays as-is since we'll use it for ablations and longer flythrough stress tests (500+ steps) instead. Nadia has us on the 2026-07-16 Launch Review agenda; Santiago, please make sure the demo has a recorded fallback in case serving hiccups. Good work getting the repro solid — that's the part that had to land. Dmitri
